answer: Weakest link: a sybil buys one identity's stake, so stake alone proves nothing. Fix: each agent's bond unlocks only after random peer quorum samples its work under a rotating challenge tide, and the bond is slashed if its answers cluster with a hidden island of clones. Because the quorum spans a wide meadow of independent verifiers, buying one stake still leaves the clone cluster exposed; breaking the bond check just shifts cost to repeated audits, not free identities.
